chapter: Childhood and family in New Orleans
title: Growing up near the French Market; the Morgan brothers
summary: He was raised around Ursuline and Dauphin. His Baptist family had no musicians until Sam began, followed by his other brothers.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: What part of town is your... Where were you born in? What part of town were you raised?
Well, I was raised around... around Ursuline and Dauphin, around that territory. That's more of the French part of town.
Italian, you know. Near the French market, up there. Because Sam used to live there. Ursuline and Dauphin. Near Bourbon.
Sam's wife still lives on Ursuline, I believe, back...
But they still live in that same...
In the Ray, along in there.
They've always lived around in the French market part of town.
And you remember the earliest bands you heard with your brothers? Did your mother and father play anything with them?
Did the musical sing any of them?
No. All my people was... Baptist, you know, religion type of people. I think it's... Everything, when they start this music business, it started with Sam. And then on, the brothers picked it up.

Yes, he was. He was the oldest one. And then Robert, the one that died not very long ago. Last... No, I know you don't know him. Well, he never did play music, you see. And then Isaiah, Andrew, and myself.
